test_cases.test_case: Top navigation displays required menus and icons
steps: 1. Observe the top navigation bar after login
2. Verify presence of Mifos logo on left
3. Verify menu items: Institution, Accounting, Reports, Admin, Self Service, Configuration Wizard
4. Verify right-side icons: global search, language selection, notifications, user profile
test_cases.expected_result: All specified menu items and icons are visible and clickable in the top navigation bar

test_cases.test_case: Left sidebar icons navigate to corresponding pages
steps: 1. Click Clients icon in left sidebar
2. Verify main content navigates to Clients page
3. Click Groups icon
4. Verify main content navigates to Groups page
5. Click Centers icon and Products icon and verify navigation
test_cases.expected_result: Each icon opens its corresponding page in the main content area and breadcrumbs update

test_cases.test_case: Breadcrumb updates for deep navigation paths
preconditions: User navigates to a nested entity detail page
steps: 1. Navigate: Institution -> Clients -> Select a client -> Open a loan account detail
2. Observe breadcrumbs at top of content area
test_cases.expected_result: Breadcrumb shows full navigation path and each crumb is clickable to return to that page

test_cases.test_case: Login with valid credentials redirects to Dashboard
steps: 1. Select Tenant (default)
2. Enter valid Username and Password
3. Optionally check Remember me
4. Click Login
test_cases.expected_result: User is authenticated and redirected to Home page (Dashboard access); welcome card displays 'Welcome, mifos!'

test_cases.test_case: Login with invalid credentials shows error
steps: 1. Enter invalid Username or Password
2. Click Login
test_cases.expected_result: Authentication fails and an error message is displayed indicating invalid credentials; user remains on login page

test_cases.test_case: Login with missing required fields keeps Login button disabled and shows inline errors
steps: 1. Leave Username empty and enter Password
2. Observe Login button state
3. Leave Password empty and enter Username
4. Observe inline validation messages and Login button
test_cases.expected_result: Login button is disabled until required fields are filled and inline validation messages displayed for empty required fields

test_cases.test_case: Remember me persists session across browser restarts
steps: 1. Login with Remember me checked
2. Close the browser completely
3. Reopen browser and access application URL
test_cases.expected_result: Session persists per application remember-me policy; user remains logged in if token valid, otherwise redirected to login

test_cases.test_case: Home page shows welcome card and system versions
preconditions: User is logged in and on Home page
steps: 1. Observe welcome card displays 'Welcome, mifos!'
2. Verify presence of 'Search Activity' input and 'Dashboard' button
3. Scroll to bottom and verify Mifos and Fineract version information displayed
test_cases.expected_result: Welcome card, search input, Dashboard button, and system version info are visible

test_cases.test_case: Dashboard displays Client Trends chart and summary cards
preconditions: User navigates to Dashboard from Home page
steps: 1. Click Dashboard button on Home page
2. Observe 'Search Activity' at top
3. Verify Client Trends chart displays legends for New Clients and Closed Clients
4. Verify summary cards for Amount Pending / Disbursed and Amount Collected
test_cases.expected_result: Chart and summary cards render; 'No Data' appears in cards if no data exists

test_cases.test_case: Global search returns grouped results and navigates to detail
preconditions: There are clients, groups, loans, savings in system
steps: 1. Click global search icon
2. Type a partial name of a client
3. Observe dropdown displays grouped results (Clients, Groups, Loans, Savings)
4. Click a client result
test_cases.expected_result: Dropdown shows matching grouped results (case-insensitive, partial matches) and clicking a result navigates to corresponding detail page

test_cases.test_case: Global search with no matches shows 'No results found'
steps: 1. Click global search icon
2. Enter gibberish/no matching text
3. Observe dropdown
test_cases.expected_result: 'No results found' message is displayed in dropdown

test_cases.test_case: Global search handles very long input and partial matches
steps: 1. Click global search icon
2. Enter extremely long string (>255 chars) and a known entity name embedded within
3. Observe results
test_cases.expected_result: Search handles input (truncates if needed) and still finds partial matches; UI does not break

test_cases.test_case: Clients page displays client table with search and status chips
preconditions: User is logged in and clients exist
steps: 1. Navigate to Institution -> Clients
2. Verify table columns: Name, Account No., External ID, Status, Office, Staff
3. Verify status chips show correct colors for Pending, Active, Closed, Rejected, Withdrawn
4. Use search field to search by name/account/external ID/mobile number
test_cases.expected_result: Client listing table displays with search functioning and status chips colored correctly

test_cases.test_case: Create Client wizard completes and creates client in Pending status
preconditions: User has permission to create clients
steps: 1. On Clients page, click Create Client
2. Fill Step 1 required fields: Office, First Name, Last Name, Submitted On
3. Fill optional fields (DOB, Gender, Staff, Mobile, Email, External ID)
4. Proceed through Address, Family Members, Identifiers steps
5. Ensure External ID is unique
6. Click Submit
test_cases.expected_result: Client is created with status Pending and detail page displays with Pending status badge and actions Activate, Edit, Reject, Withdraw

test_cases.test_case: Create Client wizard rejects missing required fields
preconditions: User is on Create Client wizard
steps: 1. Leave Office empty and fill other fields
2. Attempt to proceed or submit
3. Leave First Name or Last Name empty and attempt to proceed
4. Leave Submitted On empty and attempt to submit
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation messages prevent moving forward or submitting until required fields are filled

test_cases.test_case: Create Client rejects duplicate External ID
preconditions: An existing client has External ID 'EXT123'
steps: 1. Start Create Client wizard
2. Enter External ID as 'EXT123'
3. Complete required fields and submit
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error shown indicating External ID must be unique and client creation blocked

test_cases.test_case: Create Client with maximum allowable field lengths
preconditions: System defines max length for names and IDs
steps: 1. Enter maximum length strings for First, Middle, and Last Name, External ID, Email, and Address fields
2. Complete wizard and submit
test_cases.expected_result: Form accepts fields up to allowed lengths and creates client; if any exceed limits inline validation warns

test_cases.test_case: Bulk import clients: download template, upload valid file, view import history
preconditions: User is on Clients page and has importer permissions
steps: 1. Click Import Client
2. Download client Excel template
3. Fill template with valid client records including required fields
4. Upload completed file using upload control
5. Submit and view import history row for the job
test_cases.expected_result: Import job created, history table displays Name, Import Time, End Time, Completed status, Total Records, Success Count, Failure Count, and Download links for results

test_cases.test_case: Bulk import rejects invalid file format or malformed data
preconditions: User is on Bulk Import page
steps: 1. Attempt to upload a non-Excel file (e.g., .txt)
2. Upload Excel with missing required columns or invalid data types
3. Submit
test_cases.expected_result: Import system rejects invalid file types with error; if file uploads but contains invalid data, import job shows failure counts and downloadable error report

test_cases.test_case: Client detail page actions for Pending: Activate with valid Activation Date
preconditions: A client exists in Pending status
Activation Date is on or after Submitted On date
steps: 1. Open client detail page in Pending status
2. Click Activate
3. Enter Activation Date equal to or after submission date
4. Confirm activation
test_cases.expected_result: Client status changes to Active and activation date is displayed; action buttons update accordingly

test_cases.test_case: Activating client with Activation Date before Submitted On is rejected
preconditions: Client in Pending with Submitted On date 2021-01-10
steps: 1. Click Activate
2. Enter Activation Date 2021-01-05 (before submission)
3. Attempt to confirm activation
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error prevents activation and an error message states activation date cannot be before submission date

test_cases.test_case: Reject and Withdraw actions require a reason
steps: 1. Click Reject
2. Leave reason empty and attempt to submit
3. Enter a rejection reason and submit
4. Repeat for Withdraw action
test_cases.expected_result: Empty reason shows inline validation; providing a reason successfully changes status to Rejected or Withdrawn and detail page reflects it

test_cases.test_case: Active client cannot be activated and shows correct action set
steps: 1. Open client detail page
2. Observe available actions: Edit, Transfer Client, Close, Add Charge, New Loan, New Savings, New Share Account
3. Ensure Activate is not shown
test_cases.expected_result: Activate action is absent; actions appropriate to Active status are present

test_cases.test_case: Transfer Client to same office is blocked
preconditions: Client is Active and currently assigned to Office A
steps: 1. Click Transfer Client
2. Select destination office as Office A (same as current)
3. Attempt to submit transfer
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error prevents transfer to same office and an explanatory message is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Close client blocked if active accounts exist
preconditions: Client has active loan or savings accounts
steps: 1. Click Close on client detail page
2. Provide closure reason and attempt to close
test_cases.expected_result: System prevents closing client and shows error indicating active accounts must be closed first

test_cases.test_case: Identifiers tab prevents duplicate document keys for same client
preconditions: Identifier Document Type 'Passport' with key 'P123' exists for client
steps: 1. Go to Identifiers tab
2. Attempt to add a new identifier with same Document Type and Document Key 'P123'
3. Submit
test_cases.expected_result: Validation prevents duplicate identifier and shows error message

test_cases.test_case: Groups page create group with member clients
steps: 1. Go to Institution -> Groups
2. Click Create Group
3. Fill Name, Office, Submitted On
4. Use Add Clients search to add existing clients
5. Submit
test_cases.expected_result: Group is created and Members tab shows associated clients with links to their profiles

test_cases.test_case: Create Group rejects missing required fields
steps: 1. Leave Name or Office empty
2. Attempt to submit
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation messages prevent submission until required fields are filled

test_cases.test_case: Group detail page Generate Collection Sheet shows member rows
preconditions: Group with clients has loans or savings due
steps: 1. Open Group detail page
2. Navigate to Collection Sheet feature
3. Generate sheet for the next repayment date
test_cases.expected_result: Collection sheet displays all group clients with loan repayment amounts and savings deposit amounts for batch data entry

test_cases.test_case: Centers page create center with groups
steps: 1. Go to Centers page
2. Click Create Center
3. Fill Name, Office, Submitted On
4. Use Select and Add groups to associate groups
5. Submit
test_cases.expected_result: Center created and Groups tab lists member groups with links

test_cases.test_case: Create Loan Product full 6-step wizard with accounting cash-based
preconditions: User has permission to create products
steps: 1. Go to Loan Products and click + Create Loan Product
2. Step 1: Fill Product Name, Short Name, Fund, Start Date
3. Step 2: Select Currency and set principal min/default/max
4. Step 3: Configure amortization, interest method, days in year/month, grace fields
5. Step 4: Set Number of Repayments and frequency defaults
6. Step 5: Add charges
7. Step 6: Select Cash-based accounting and map GL accounts for all required entries
8. Submit
test_cases.expected_result: Loan product created and appears in listing; opening detail view shows created settings

test_cases.test_case: Loan Product wizard validation for missing required fields
steps: 1. Leave Product Name or Short Name empty in Step 1 and attempt to proceed
2. In Step 2 leave currency unselected and attempt to proceed
3. In Step 6 choose Cash-based but leave GL account mappings blank and attempt to submit
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validations prevent proceeding/submitting and show appropriate error messages for required fields and missing GL mappings

test_cases.test_case: Loan Product with overlapping interest tiers and validate UI warnings
steps: 1. Configure interest rate chart with overlapping Period From/To ranges
2. Attempt to save product
test_cases.expected_result: Validation warns about overlapping tiers and prevents save until ranges are corrected

test_cases.test_case: Create Savings Product wizard and enable overdraft with limits
preconditions: GL accounts available for Cash-based accounting
steps: 1. Go to Savings Products and click + Create Savings Product
2. Fill Step 1: Product Name and Short Name
3. Step 2: Choose Currency
4. Step 3: Configure interest rate and posting periods
5. Step 4: Enable Is Overdraft Allowed and set Maximum Overdraft Amount and Overdraft Interest Rate
6. Step 5: Add charges
7. Step 6: Choose Cash-based accounting and map required GL accounts
8. Submit
test_cases.expected_result: Savings product created with overdraft enabled and settings stored

test_cases.test_case: Savings Product blocks invalid numeric ranges (min > max)
steps: 1. In Step 2 set Decimal Places negative or non-integer
2. In Step 3 set Minimum Opening Balance greater than some default constraints
3. Set Minimum Balance for Interest Calculation greater than product Maximum (if defined)
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation errors are displayed for invalid numeric ranges and non-integer decimals; submission blocked

test_cases.test_case: Create Share Product with market price rows and accounting
steps: 1. Go to Share Products and click + Create Share Product
2. Step 1: Fill Name, Short Name, Description
3. Step 2: Select Currency
4. Step 3: Enter Total Number of Shares, Shares to be Issued, Nominal Price
5. Step 4: Configure settings like Minimum/Maximum Shares per Client
6. Step 5: Add market price rows with From Date and Share Value
7. Step 6: Add charges
8. Step 7: Choose Cash-based accounting and map required GL accounts
9. Submit
test_cases.expected_result: Share product created successfully and appears in listing with total shares

test_cases.test_case: Share Product rejects missing mandatory fields
steps: 1. Leave required fields Product Name or Short Name or Description empty
2. Attempt to proceed or submit
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation prevents submission and displays required field errors

test_cases.test_case: Create Charge with correct Charge Applies To and time types for Loans
steps: 1. Navigate to Charges page and click + Create Charge
2. Enter Charge Name, select Charge Applies To = Loan
3. Select Currency and Charge Time Type = Disbursement or Installment Fee
4. Choose Charge Calculation Type and Amount
5. Submit
test_cases.expected_result: Charge definition is created and appears in Charges listing

test_cases.test_case: Charge creation blocks missing Currency or Amount
steps: 1. Leave Currency empty and attempt to submit
2. Leave Amount empty and attempt to submit
3. Set negative amount and submit
test_cases.expected_result: Validation errors shown for missing currency, missing amount, and invalid negative amounts

test_cases.test_case: Create Floating Rate with multiple rate periods and set as base lending rate
preconditions: No other base lending rate exists or user will clear it
steps: 1. Go to Floating Rates and click + Create Floating Rate
2. Enter Floating Rate Name, check Is Base Lending Rate
3. Add multiple Rate Periods rows with From Date and Interest Rate
4. Submit
test_cases.expected_result: Floating rate created and marked as base lending rate; listing shows it as base and active

test_cases.test_case: Floating Rates prevents setting multiple base lending rates
preconditions: A base lending rate already exists in the system
steps: 1. Create a new floating rate and check Is Base Lending Rate
2. Attempt to submit
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error prevents creating another base lending rate and prompts user to uncheck or change existing base

test_cases.test_case: Floating Rate differential rows apply relative adjustments
preconditions: Loan product linked to floating rate
steps: 1. Create floating rate with Rate Period having Is Differential Rate checked and positive/negative values
2. Link a loan product to this floating rate
3. Create loan using product and check computed interest rate for applicable period
test_cases.expected_result: Loan interest rate is computed as base rate plus/minus differential rate for the applicable rate period

test_cases.test_case: Create Delinquency Range and Bucket and link to loan product
preconditions: User has permission to create delinquency configurations
steps: 1. Go to Delinquency Ranges, click + Create Range
2. Enter Classification, Minimum Age Days, (optionally) Maximum Age Days and save
3. Go to Delinquency Buckets, create a bucket and add the created ranges in sequence
4. Link the bucket to a Loan Product in product settings
test_cases.expected_result: Range and bucket created; loan product linked; overdue loans will be classified into defined ranges

test_cases.test_case: Delinquency Range requires Minimum Age Days
steps: 1. Leave Minimum Age Days empty and attempt to save
2. Enter non-numeric value and attempt to save
test_cases.expected_result: Validation errors for required minimum age and numeric format; save blocked

test_cases.test_case: Initiate new Loan Application from Client Detail and submit as Pending Approval
steps: 1. On Client Detail page, click New Loan
2. Step 1: Select Product Name, enter Loan Officer, Principal within product bounds, Number of Repayments, Interest Rate within product bounds
3. Fill Steps 2-4 as needed, add charges and collateral if any
4. Submit
test_cases.expected_result: Loan is created in 'Submitted and Pending Approval' status and appears in client Accounts tab under Loans

test_cases.test_case: Loan application blocks principal and interest outside product bounds
preconditions: Loan product has defined min/max principal and min/max interest
steps: 1. Select product with min principal 1000 and max 10000
2. Enter principal 500 (below min) and attempt to proceed
3. Enter interest rate above product max and attempt to proceed
test_cases.expected_result: Validation errors surface indicating values are outside allowed product bounds and prevent submission

test_cases.test_case: Approve Loan as Pending Approval with valid Approved On Date and Disburse subsequently
preconditions: Loan in Submitted and Pending Approval status
steps: 1. Open loan detail page in Pending Approval
2. Click Approve and enter Approved On Date and Approved Amount
3. Confirm approval; status changes to Approved
4. Click Disburse, enter Disbursed On Date and Transaction Amount, select Payment Type and details
5. Confirm disbursement
test_cases.expected_result: Loan status progresses to Approved and then to Active after Disbursement with appropriate transactions recorded; if 'Disburse to Savings' selected, savings account credited

test_cases.test_case: Disbursement blocked when transaction amount exceeds approved amount
preconditions: Loan is Approved with Approved Amount 5000
steps: 1. Click Disburse
2. Enter Transaction Amount 6000 (greater than approved amount)
3. Attempt to confirm disbursement
test_cases.expected_result: Validation prevents disbursement and shows error indicating transaction amount cannot exceed approved amount

test_cases.test_case: Make partial repayment and verify schedule updates
preconditions: Loan is Active with outstanding installments
steps: 1. Open loan detail page and go to Make Repayment
2. Enter Transaction Date and Transaction Amount less than total due (partial)
3. Select Payment Type and submit
test_cases.expected_result: Partial repayment applied per configured repayment strategy, transactions recorded, and repayment schedule reflects partial payment with updated outstanding amounts

test_cases.test_case: Full settlement closes loan and marks obligations met
preconditions: Loan is Active with outstanding balance less than or equal to provided full payment
steps: 1. Click Make Repayment and enter Transaction Amount equal to full outstanding balance
2. Submit
test_cases.expected_result: Loan status changes to Closed (Obligations met) and transactions show zero outstanding amount

test_cases.test_case: Create Savings account application and approve -> activate -> deposit
steps: 1. From Client Detail, click New Savings
2. Select Product, fill Submitted On and required fields, submit (status Submitted and Pending Approval)
3. Approve the account
4. Activate account
5. Make a Deposit with Transaction Date, Amount, Payment Type and details
test_cases.expected_result: Account status flows from Pending to Approved to Active; deposit credits account and Transactions tab shows the deposit with updated balances

test_cases.test_case: Savings withdrawal blocked when exceeding available balance without overdraft
preconditions: Active savings account with balance 500 and overdraft not enabled
steps: 1. Click Withdraw
2. Enter Transaction Amount 600
3. Submit
test_cases.expected_result: System shows error that withdrawal exceeds available balance and prevents transaction

test_cases.test_case: Savings withdrawal allowed with overdraft enabled up to limit
preconditions: Active savings account with overdraft enabled and limit 200
steps: 1. Click Withdraw and enter amount within balance+overdraft limit (e.g., balance 100, withdraw 250)
2. Submit with payment type and details
test_cases.expected_result: Withdrawal succeeds provided amount does not exceed available balance plus overdraft limit; account balance updates accordingly

test_cases.test_case: Create Share Account application and approve/activate/purchase additional shares
preconditions: Client has Active savings account for charges
Share product exists and client within per-client min/max
steps: 1. From Client Detail, click New Share Account
2. Select Share Product, enter Requested Shares within bounds, link Savings Account for charges, submit
3. Approve with Approved Shares and Approved Date
4. Activate account
5. Apply Additional Shares and verify transaction debits linked savings account
test_cases.expected_result: Share account moves through statuses and additional purchases debited from linked savings; Purchased Shares tab shows entries

test_cases.test_case: Share Account application rejects requested shares outside product per-client bounds
preconditions: Product min shares per client 10 and max 100
steps: 1. Request 5 shares and submit
2. Request 150 shares and submit
test_cases.expected_result: Validation errors prevent submission with messages indicating requested shares are outside allowed per-client min/max

test_cases.test_case: Create Fixed Deposit account and process premature closure
preconditions: FD product exists with pre-closure allowed and penal interest configured
steps: 1. From Client Detail, create FD account with Deposit Amount and Deposit Period
2. Approve and Activate account
3. Initiate Premature Close and confirm required inputs
4. Verify compute of penal interest and process closure
test_cases.expected_result: Premature close processed per product settings; maturity amount and penalties applied correctly and account status updated

test_cases.test_case: Create Recurring Deposit account and process deposit transactions
preconditions: RD product exists and client Active
steps: 1. From Client Detail, create RD with Mandatory Deposit Amount and Frequency, set Expected First Deposit On
2. Approve and Activate account
3. Make a deposit for an installment
4. Verify deposit reflected in schedule and Transactions
test_cases.expected_result: Deposits accepted per schedule, total deposits and running balance updated; RD account details show correct maturity estimate

test_cases.test_case: Chart of Accounts create GL Account with unique GL Code
steps: 1. Go to Chart of Accounts and click + Create GL Account
2. Select Account Type and Parent Header account (if creating detail)
3. Enter unique GL Code and Account Name, choose Account Usage = Detail
4. Submit
test_cases.expected_result: GL account created and appears in hierarchical tree with correct color coding and attributes

test_cases.test_case: GL Account creation blocks duplicate GL Code
preconditions: An existing GL account uses GL Code '1000'
steps: 1. Attempt to create new GL account with GL Code '1000'
2. Fill other required fields and submit
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error indicates GL Code must be unique and prevents creation

test_cases.test_case: Add Journal Entry with balanced debits and credits
preconditions: User has permission to add journal entries
steps: 1. Go to Journal Entries and click + Add Journal Entry
2. Select Office and Currency and set Transaction Date
3. Add two entry lines: Debit GL A amount 1000, Credit GL B amount 1000
4. Submit
test_cases.expected_result: Journal entry saved successfully; listing shows entry with balanced debits and credits and no difference

test_cases.test_case: Journal Entry prevents unbalanced entries
steps: 1. Add entry lines where Debit total != Credit total (e.g., Debit 1000, Credit 900)
2. Attempt to submit
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error displays debit/credit difference and prevents submission

test_cases.test_case: Create Closing Entry blocks further journal entries on or before closing date
preconditions: User has permission to create closures
steps: 1. Go to Closing Entries and click + Create Closure
2. Select Office and Closing Date 2022-12-31 and add comments
3. Submit closure
4. Attempt to create a Journal Entry with Transaction Date 2022-12-31
test_cases.expected_result: Closure created successfully and new journal entry with Transaction Date on or before closing date is prevented with an error

test_cases.test_case: Create Accounting Rule with multiple debit and credit entries
steps: 1. Navigate to Accounting Rules and click + Create Rule
2. Leave Office blank to apply to all
3. Enter Rule Name and add multiple Debit Accounts and Credit Accounts, check Allow Multiple Debit/Credit as needed
4. Submit
test_cases.expected_result: Accounting rule saved and appears in listing with configured debit/credit accounts

test_cases.test_case: Financial Activity Mapping allows mapping of unmapped activities
preconditions: There are unmapped financial activities and GL accounts exist
steps: 1. Go to Financial Activity Mappings and click + Create Mapping
2. Select an unmapped Financial Activity and a GL Account
3. Submit
test_cases.expected_result: Mapping saved and listed; activity cannot appear in unmapped dropdown again

test_cases.test_case: Financial Activity Mapping prevents duplicate mapping of same activity
steps: 1. Try to create a new mapping selecting 'Fund Source'
2. Submit
test_cases.expected_result: System rejects mapping saying activity already mapped

test_cases.test_case: Provisioning Criteria creation with multiple definitions
steps: 1. Go to Provisioning Criteria and click + Create
2. Enter Criteria Name
3. Add multiple Definition rows specifying Loan Product, Category, Min/Max Age, Provisioning Percentage, Liability and Expense accounts
4. Submit
test_cases.expected_result: Provisioning criteria saved and appears in list

test_cases.test_case: Create Provisioning Entry generates journal entries based on criteria
preconditions: There are overdue loans matching criteria
steps: 1. Go to Provisioning Entries and click + Create Provisioning Entry
2. Confirm generation
3. Review generated journal entry details
test_cases.expected_result: Provisioning journal entries created and appear in list showing breakdown by product and category

test_cases.test_case: Create Office and validate hierarchy display
preconditions: User has permission to create offices
steps: 1. Go to Offices and click + Create Office
2. Enter Office Name, select Parent Office (Head Office if root), set Opened On
3. Submit
4. Verify office appears in hierarchical table
test_cases.expected_result: Office created and hierarchy updated with clickable Office Name linking to details

test_cases.test_case: Office creation requires Parent Office selection except for Head Office
steps: 1. Attempt to create a non-Head Office without selecting Parent Office
2. Submit
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error requires Parent Office selection and prevents creation

test_cases.test_case: Create Employee with Loan Officer flag and verify presence in dropdowns
preconditions: User has permission to create employees
steps: 1. Go to Employees and click + Create Employee
2. Fill Office, First Name, Last Name, check Is Loan Officer, set Joining Date
3. Submit
4. When creating a loan, verify new employee appears in Loan Officer dropdown
test_cases.expected_result: Employee created and is selectable as Loan Officer

test_cases.test_case: Employee creation blocks missing required fields
steps: 1. Leave Office empty and attempt to submit
2. Leave First or Last Name empty and submit
test_cases.expected_result: Validation messages displayed and creation prevented

test_cases.test_case: Create Teller and allocate Cashier, then perform allocate/settle cash operations
preconditions: User has permission to create tellers and cashiers
steps: 1. Create Teller with Office, Teller Name, Start Date
2. Open Teller detail and click + Allocate Cashier
3. Select Staff, Start Date and Is Full Day, submit
4. On Cashier detail, perform Allocate Cash to add opening balance and Settle Cash to return cash
5. Verify Cashier Transactions list shows allocations and settlements
test_cases.expected_result: Teller, cashier allocation and cash operations recorded with running balance updates

test_cases.test_case: Create User with roles, password policy enforcement and send password option
preconditions: Username is unique and email valid
steps: 1. Go to Users and click + Create User
2. Enter unique Username, First Name, Last Name, valid Email, select Office and Staff, enter Password meeting policy and Repeat Password correctly
3. Select Roles and optionally check Send Password to Email
4. Submit
test_cases.expected_result: User created, appears in Users list; if Send Password to Email checked, system indicates email sent

test_cases.test_case: User creation rejects duplicate username and password mismatch
steps: 1. Attempt to create user with Username 'jdoe'
2. Enter Password and a different Repeat Password
3. Submit
test_cases.expected_result: Validation errors for non-unique username and password mismatch displayed; creation blocked

test_cases.test_case: Create Role and assign permissions via matrix
steps: 1. Click + Create Role, fill Role Name and Description and submit
2. Open the role and use permissions matrix to toggle a set of permissions (e.g., Portfolio Read, Accounting Write)
3. Save changes
test_cases.expected_result: Role created and permissions saved; users assigned this role gain/lose access accordingly

test_cases.test_case: Run a report with parameters and export to CSV
steps: 1. Go to Reports and select Active Loans Details
2. Fill parameters like Office, Date Range
3. Click Run Report
4. After data loads, click Export and select CSV
test_cases.expected_result: Report generated and CSV downloaded with expected data matching on-screen table

test_cases.test_case: Report parameter validation for invalid date ranges
preconditions: Report parameters include From and To Date
steps: 1. Enter From Date after To Date
2. Click Run Report
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error indicating invalid date range and blocking report generation

test_cases.test_case: Process Account Transfer between two savings accounts with sufficient balance
preconditions: From account has sufficient available balance
steps: 1. Go to Account Transfers form
2. Select From Office, From Client, From Account Type = Savings, From Account
3. Select To Office/Client/Account and enter Transfer Amount and Transfer Date
4. Submit
test_cases.expected_result: Transfer processed: source debited and destination credited; transaction appears on both account transaction lists

test_cases.test_case: Account Transfer blocked when amount exceeds available balance
steps: 1. Attempt transfer with amount greater than available balance
2. Submit
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error prevents transfer and states amount exceeds available balance

test_cases.test_case: Create Standing Instruction with periodic recurrence
steps: 1. Go to Standing Instructions and click + Create
2. Enter Name, From Account, To Account, Amount, Validity From/Till, select Recurrence Type = Periodic, set Frequency and Interval
3. Submit and enable instruction
